app_fee.value: The application fee is USD 75 for international applicants (USD 60 for domestic); one application and fee covers up to two campuses or majors.
app_fee.quote: The graduate application fee is $60 (U.S. dollars) for domestic applicants and $75 (U.S. dollars) for international applicants. | With just one application and a single fee, you can apply to up to two different campuses or majors

fee_waiver.value: Fee waivers are tied to recognised undergraduate achievement or Purdue-affiliated recruitment events; the economic-hardship waiver is only for US citizens and permanent residents.
fee_waiver.quote: Purdue provides application fee waivers to recognize outstanding undergraduate achievement, and engage prospective students in recruitment events where Purdue is affiliated. | Applicants who are U.S. citizens or permanent residents experiencing economic hardship may request a waiver of the application fee.

gre_general.value: The graduate school does not require the GRE; each program sets its own GRE policy (see the program record).
gre_general.quote: Although the Graduate Record Examination (GRE) is not an Office of the Vice Provost for Graduate Students and Postdoctoral Scholars (OGSPS) admission requirement, many graduate programs require this test.

toefl_min.value: TOEFL iBT 80 overall with section minimums (R19, L14, S18, W18) for tests taken before 21 January 2026; for tests on or after that date the minimum is 4.0 overall on the new 1-6 scale. Many programs set higher minimums.
toefl_min.quote: Minimum TOEFL Scores Required by OGSPS for Admission (For exams taken before January 21, 2026) | Minimum Overall Required for Admission 80‡ | Minimum TOEFL Scores Required by OGSPS for Admission (For exams taken on or after January 21, 2026) | Minimum Overall Required for Admission 4.0‡ | Some graduate programs require higher minimum scores than those listed above

ielts_min.value: IELTS Academic 6.5 overall (Reading 6.5, Listening 6.0, Speaking 6.0, Writing 5.5); some programs require more.
ielts_min.quote: Minimum IELTS Scores Required by OGSPS for Admission | Minimum Overall Required for Admission 6.5

english_waiver.value: The test waiver applies only to degrees from countries where English is the native language; India is not on Purdue's list, so Indian applicants need a TOEFL, IELTS or Duolingo score.
english_waiver.quote: The OGSPS will routinely waive the English Proficiency testing requirements for applicants who have received a baccalaureate degree or graduate or professional degree, within the last 36 months prior to the time of recommendation for admission, from a school where English is the primary language of instruction in a country/location where English is the native language. | Official English-speaking countries/locations, in addition to the U.S., include

notes: Duolingo English Test accepted (115 overall). From August 15, 2026, Indiana law adds review steps for applicants from certain countries (not India). Programs may set higher English minimums; see each program record.
